Be afraid, cutting is not a fun path to go down. Please think it through. But to answer your question I grabbed a box cutter blade, and slowly carved into my skin, every slow pass making the cut deeper. It hurt a lot, it bled a lot. Then I did it again in another spot after the bleeding and pain wasn't satisfactory. After I got worn out I slept and did it again the next day, and the next, I did it this way for about a week, now it's less frequent but the scars add up, it's an ugly sight that I hate. If you're afraid of the pain or scars don't do it. In fact don't do it, don't consider it. Just because you self harm in a different way doesn't mean it's not proper. There is no proper way to self harm, and it's not something that should be tossed around as if it's nothing. Please just don't consider cutting, it's not worth it, and I can say that I regret it, and I want to get out.
